    The finite-category attachment for the BGRS ray product #

    This file isolates the representative-level inputs needed to transport factorization comparability and cancellation to the BGRS ray category, derives both from distributive Hom structure and Artinian endpoint rings, then packages the generic finite-ray-category consequences.

        theorem LargeIndecomposable.exists_nonspecial_middle_factor_of_comp {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] {X Y Z : C} [IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End Y)] {f : X ⟶ Z} (g₀ : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hfactor : f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g₀ h) :
        ∃ (g : X ⟶ Y), f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g h ∧ ¬IsBGRSSpecialZero g h

        Any nonzero ordinary factorization can be adjusted at its middle object so that the same right factor forms a nonexceptional BGRS pair. Repeatedly absorbing a hypothetical exceptional radical insertion into the left factor would eventually put that factor in a zero power of the middle Jacobson radical, contradicting nonvanishing. This is the representative-level core of the stable-path refinement used in BGRS 2.2.

        Assemble the finite-ray-category structure on a BGRS ray category.

        The nilpotence and source-stabilizer fields are consequences of finite Hom sets, cancellation, and the already transported identity and skeletality facts; they are not additional source hypotheses.
